title: Layered, Leavened, Luxurious Saudi-Arabian Lamb Lasagna
description: A rich, comforting dish from Saudi Arabia featuring tender lamb, fragrant spices, and crispy white bread.
instructions: In a large mixing bowl, combine the ground lamb, white bread flour, salt, black pepper, cumin, coriander, garlic, and onion. Mix well.
Add the bechamel sauce to the lamb mixture and mix until just combined.
Roll out the dough to a thickness of about 1/4 inch. Cut into rectangles that are about 10 inches long and 6 inches wide.
Spread a layer of the lamb mixture onto the dough, leaving a 1-inch border around the edges.
Repeat the layers, starting with the dough, then the lamb mixture, and finally the cheese.
Place the lasagna on a cedar plank, brushing the edges with water to seal the dish.
Bake for 40 minutes, or until the crust is golden brown and the filling is hot and bubbly.
Remove from the oven and sprinkle with fresh parsley.
Let rest for 10 minutes before slicing and serving.
